text: sambahulasuttaṃ [768] ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā bhikkhū kosalesu viharanti aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe . atha kho te bhikkhū vassaṃ vutthā temāsaccayena cārikaṃ pakkamiṃsu . [769] atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā te bhikkhū apassantī paridevamānā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi arati viya mejjaṃ khāyati bahuke disvāna vivitte āsane te cittakathā bahussutā kome gotamasāvakā gatāti . [770] evaṃ vutte aññatarā devatā taṃ devataṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi magadhaṃ gatā kosalaṃ gatā ekacciyā pana vajjibhūmiyā makaṭā 1 viya saṅghacārino 2 aniketā viharanti bhikkhavoti . pañcamaṃ
